$description:
Canonical shape for a Penpot rect with a fill bound to a design token via Penpot 2.x's appliedTokens map. Discovered 2026-05-17 via REST probe against design.hz.ledoweb.com (Penpot version 2.15.3). The Penpot source schema is `cto/schema:applied-tokens` in `common/src/app/common/types/token.cljc` — confirmed via the Penpot GitHub repo. Field-name notes:

- The shape attribute is `appliedTokens` in JSON / camelCase responses; `applied-tokens` (kebab-case) when posting via `update-file` PCS mod-obj operations.
- The value of each key inside `appliedTokens` is a token name string. Penpot resolves it against whichever token set is currently active (the `$themes` machinery decides which set is active per theme).
- The token name is the GROUP-PREFIXED path (e.g., `color.surface.canvas`), NOT the fully-qualified path including the set name (e.g., NOT `theme-light.color.surface.canvas`).
- A literal `fills` value should always be set alongside `appliedTokens.fill` as a fallback for when no theme set is active.

Key-name reference (subset, from Penpot source):
  - color tokens:   fill, stroke-color
  - sizing tokens:  width, height, layout-item-min-w, layout-item-max-w, layout-item-min-h, layout-item-max-h
  - spacing tokens: p1, p2, p3, p4, m1, m2, m3, m4, row-gap, column-gap
  - radius tokens:  r1, r2, r3, r4
  - typography:     font-size, font-family, font-weight, letter-spacing, line-height

post_persist_returns._comment: Penpot normalises kebab-case → camelCase on read.
